note: Add `codeExtractNative(filename, code, packageName, platform, runtime)` to both engines (part of #411). It compiles a file for React Native: Devup UI elements imported from `@devup-ui/react` become React Native components (`Box` → `View`, `Text` → `Text`, `Image` → `Image`, `Input` → `TextInput`, `Button` → `Pressable`, `Flex`/`VStack`/`Center` → `View` with their flex styles), and their style props become style objects hoisted into one `StyleSheet.create` per file and passed through `style`. `_ios`, `_android` and `_web` resolve at build time from `platform`. A style React Native cannot take is a build error naming the prop, as are responsive values, themes and `_pressed`, which need a runtime this release does not include. Web output is unchanged.
